I refactored `TestSymmetry454Chronology_test_minus_TemporalUnit` for understandability while preserving identical runtime behaviour:
- Dropped the ~10 unused data providers (`data_samples`, `data_ranges`, `data_with`, etc.) and the dozens of unused imports that the original carried over, leaving only what this single `minus` test exercises.
- Reordered each data row to read naturally left-to-right as `base date → amount/unit → expected result`, matching the operation under test, and gave the parameters self-explanatory names (`baseYear/Month/Day`, `expectedYear/Month/Day`) instead of the misleading `expected*`/`year/month/dom` ordering.
- Grouped rows by unit with comments and added Javadoc — the same `Symmetry454Date.of(...)` calls, `.minus(amount, unit)` calls, and `assertEquals` outcomes as the original.
